correctness.rationale: For all n≥3, minimal nonfaces are exactly triples of the two rim edges meeting a core vertex and its pendant edge. The complement of the full rim facet has an exhaustive matching toggling the least available spoke at each proper fixed rim selection, with an acyclic order argument. A contractible CW subcomplex can be collapsed without altering ordinary homotopy; the quotient is the sphere with the rim permutation action. Rotation and reflection signed permutations give the integral character. Finite group averaging proves the rational orbit-space statement, and invariant-support analysis proves the full-rotation fixed locus. Replayed standalone verify.py for n=3..8; finiteness is corroboration only.

value.rationale: For the natural two-matching complex of an unbounded family of cycle-corona graphs, the topological sphere type is already known but its full symmetry action is not determined by this fact. The theorem gives the integral top-homology D_n module, detects a sharp mod-four rational orbit-space homology transition, and identifies the full-rotation fixed set via a concrete invariant contraction. This is a meaningful equivariant refinement of an established topological object, not a new sphere count or arbitrary small parameter sample.
